title: Responsible AI Safety and Education Act
last_action: Signed by the Governor as Chapter 699.
summary: Requires covered frontier-model developers to publish information about safety protocols and report specified critical-harm incidents to New York within 72 hours; it also creates a frontier-model oversight office within the Department of Financial Services.
committee_dynamics: The final enacted framework was negotiated to emphasize transparency and incident reporting for the largest frontier developers.

responsible_agencies: New York Department of Financial Services

agency_status.agency: New York Department of Financial Services
agency_status.detail: The statute creates an oversight office; this starter record has not yet completed an official implementation inventory.

verification_level: Official legislature and governor sources verified.
